reviews.reason: In s0116, 「慕容永以丕至平陽，恐不自固，乃遣使求假道還東，丕弗許。」 attests 慕容永 (Murong Yong) in the chapter narrative as Western Yan ruler. Accepted canonical assignment preserved; this report does not merge or split dossiers. Ambiguity remains (zh:慕容永 capped at 8/19 dossiers; 7 bounded candidate header(s) disclosed).

Accepted canonical assignment preserved; this report does not merge or split dossiers. Ambiguity remains (zh:苻坚 capped at 8/82 dossiers; en:fu jian capped at 8/15 dossiers; 8 bounded candidate header(s) disclosed).

In s0098, 「是天水姜延、馮翊寇明、河東王昭、新平張晏、京兆杜敏、扶風馬郎、建忠高平牧官都尉王敏等咸承檄起兵，各有眾數萬，遣使應丕」 attests 馬郎 (Ma Lang) in the chapter narrative as Loyalist of Fufeng. Accepted canonical assignment preserved; this report does not merge or split dossiers.

In s0318, 「健既承家，克隆凶緒，率思歸之眾，投山西之隙，據億丈之岩險，」 attests 苻健 (Fu Jian (founder)) in the chapter narrative as Founder of Former Qin. Accepted canonical assignment preserved; this report does not merge or split dossiers. In s0089, 「馬，張蠔為太尉，王騰為驃騎大將軍、儀同三司，徐義為司空，苻沖為車騎大將軍、尚書令、儀同三司，俱石子為衛大將軍、尚書左」 attests 苻沖 (Fu Chong) in the chapter narrative as Former Qin Director of the Secretariat. Accepted canonical assignment preserved; this report does not merge or split dossiers. Ambiguity remains (1 bounded candidate header(s) disclosed).

桓 in the paired binome 桓文 is the conventional short title for Duke Huan of Qi in historical rhetoric; English on the same unit already renders Duke Huan. This is not evidence that 齊桓公 appears in chapter Chinese, and it does not authorize a canonical merge. Independent identity case: retain canonical membership for jinshu:115:p030 (Duke Huan of Qi/齊桓公); witness 「此桓文之舉也。」.

Accepted canonical assignment preserved; this report does not merge or split dossiers. Ambiguity remains (zh:少康 capped at 8/24 dossiers; 7 bounded candidate header(s) disclosed).
